about: The plug-ins the Earth Atlas offers to load (ADR 0027). Each file exports create(api); see README.md.

plugins.title: vorticity and divergence
plugins.description: Relative vorticity and divergence of the wind, by centred differences on the sphere.

plugins.title: air parcels
plugins.description: Parcels carried through the wind from a ring around the chosen place, or a lattice over the globe.

plugins.title: optimal interpolation
plugins.description: A background analysed toward observations: weather stations, buoys or your own sensors, or a second model at a lattice of points.

plugins.title: the barotropic model
plugins.description: The barotropic vorticity equation from the 500 hPa wind, verified against the source.

plugins.title: vorticity and divergence (Python)
plugins.description: The same diagnostic written in Python, run by the server on numpy.

plugins.title: vorticity and divergence (C++)
plugins.description: The same diagnostic written in C++, compiled and run by the server; needs a C++ compiler on the serving computer.

plugins.title: advection by the wind (C++)
plugins.description: The temperature chosen carried by the wind chosen, by a semi-Lagrangian scheme on the sphere in a C++ program in the server, verified against the source's later times beside persistence; needs a C++ compiler on the serving computer (or g++ in WSL on Windows).

plugins.title: air parcels (C++)
plugins.description: Parcels carried through the wind from a ring around the chosen place, or a lattice, by a Runge-Kutta step on the sphere in a C++ program in the server; needs a C++ compiler on the serving computer (or g++ in WSL on Windows).

plugins.title: successive correction (C++)
plugins.description: The 2 m temperature analysed at the instant toward weather stations, buoys or your own sensors by Cressman's successive corrections, in a C++ program in the server; needs a C++ compiler on the serving computer (or g++ in WSL on Windows).

plugins.title: vegetation from Sentinel-2 (NDVI)
plugins.description: The vegetation index of the least cloudy Sentinel-2 scene of the last days, at 20 or 40 m in a box around the chosen place; optionally its change since a year before. Needs a chosen place and the network.

plugins.title: people exposed to heat or wind
plugins.description: People where the forecast's greatest 2 m temperature, or 10 m wind, exceeds a threshold; by country and by province.

plugins.title: terrain and water
plugins.description: Slope and the area draining through each cell, from the relief; with a place chosen, its watershed, its main stem and its way to the sea.

plugins.title: fire weather
plugins.description: The Canadian Fire Weather Index System over the forecast days, from the weather at local noon and the rain of the day before. Not a warning service.

plugins.title: heat
plugins.description: Daily maxima of the wet-bulb temperature and the heat index, and the excess of the day's maximum over the month's normal. Not a warning service.

plugins.title: heavy rain
plugins.description: The rain of the last 24 and 72 hours from the precipitation rate, and as a fraction of the month's normal. Not a warning service.

plugins.title: tsunami travel times
plugins.description: The first arrival of a tsunami's long wave over the bathymetry, from the chosen place or the latest large shallow earthquake. Not a warning service.

plugins.title: aftershocks
plugins.description: The chance of aftershocks of magnitude 5, 6 and 7 or more over the next day, week and month (Reasenberg and Jones 1989). Not a warning service.

plugins.title: volcanic ash
plugins.description: Ash parcels from an eruption column, carried by the forecast wind and settling to the ground. Not a warning service.
